headline: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Friday directed authorities to prepare a clear roadmap and time-bound targets for a 100 per cent digital payments system, and ordered a campaign to encourage electricity and gas bill payments via QR codes, Dawn reports.

card.kicker: PM ne roadmap talab kar liya
card.desc: Bijli aur gas bill QR code se ada karne ki muhim chalegi

caption:
Pakistan mein 100% digital payments ki taraf bara qadam!
Dawn ke mutabiq PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Friday ko 100% digital payments nizam ke liye wazeh roadmap aur time-bound targets talab kar liye. Bijli aur gas ke bill QR code se ada karne ki media muhim chalai jayegi, aur 15 November se Asaan Assignment Account ki cheque payments band ho kar Raast se hongi.
Kya aap bill QR code se ada karte hain? Comment mein batayein 👇
